blade-1998.label: Blade (1998)
blade-1998.title: Blade
blade-1998.overview: The Daywalker known as "Blade" - a half-vampire, half-mortal man - becomes the protector of humanity against an underground army of vampires.

x-men-2000.label: X-Men (2000)
x-men-2000.title: X-Men
x-men-2000.overview: Two mutants, Rogue and Wolverine, come to a private academy for their kind whose resident superhero team, the X-Men, must oppose a terrorist organization with similar powers.

spider-man-2002.label: Spider-Man (2002)
spider-man-2002.title: Spider-Man
spider-man-2002.overview: After being bitten by a genetically altered spider at Oscorp, nerdy but endearing high school student Peter Parker is endowed with amazing powers to become the superhero known as Spider-Man.

blade-ii-2002.label: Blade II (2002)
blade-ii-2002.title: Blade II
blade-ii-2002.overview: Blade forms an uneasy alliance with the vampire council in order to combat the Reapers, who are feeding on vampires.

x2-2003.label: X2 (2003)
x2-2003.title: X2
x2-2003.overview: Professor Charles Xavier and his team of genetically gifted superheroes face a rising tide of anti-mutant sentiment led by Col. William Stryker. Storm, Wolverine and Jean Grey must join Magneto and Mystique to unhinge Stryker's scheme to exterminate all mutants.

spider-man-2-2004.label: Spider-Man 2 (2004)
spider-man-2-2004.title: Spider-Man 2
spider-man-2-2004.overview: Peter Parker is going through a major identity crisis. Burned out from being Spider-Man, he decides to shelve his superhero alter ego, which leaves the city suffering in the wake of carnage left by the evil Doc Ock. In the meantime, Parker still can't act on his feelings for Mary Jane Watson, a girl he's loved since childhood. A certain anger begins to brew in his best friend Harry Osborn as well...

blade-trinity-2004.label: Blade: Trinity (2004)
blade-trinity-2004.title: Blade: Trinity
blade-trinity-2004.overview: For years, Blade has fought against the vampires in the cover of the night. But now, after falling into the crosshairs of the FBI, he is forced out into the daylight, where he is driven to join forces with a clan of human vampire hunters he never knew existed—The Nightstalkers. Together with Abigail and Hannibal, two deftly trained Nightstalkers, Blade follows a trail of blood to the ancient creature that is also hunting him—the original vampire, Dracula.

daredevil-2004.label: Daredevil (2004)
daredevil-2004.title: Daredevil
daredevil-2004.overview: By day, blind attorney Matt Murdock toils for justice in Hell's Kitchen. By night, he's Daredevil, The Man Without Fear - a powerful, masked vigilante stalking the dark streets with an uncanny "radar sense" that allows him to "see" with superhuman capabilities. But when the love of his life, fiery Elektra Natchios, is targeted by New York City's ruthless Kingpin of crime and his deadly assassin Bullseye, Daredevil may be about to meet his match.

elektra.label: Elektra
elektra.title: Elektra
elektra.overview: Elektra the warrior survives a near-death experience, becomes an assassin-for-hire, and tries to protect her two latest targets, a single father and his young daughter, from a group of supernatural assassins.

fantastic-four.label: Fantastic Four
fantastic-four.title: Fantastic Four
fantastic-four.overview: During a space voyage, four scientists are altered by cosmic rays: Reed Richards gains the ability to stretch his body; Sue Storm can become invisible; Johnny Storm controls fire; and Ben Grimm is turned into a super-strong … thing. Together, these "Fantastic Four" must now thwart the evil plans of Dr. Doom and save the world from certain destruction.

x-men-the-last-stand-2006.label: X-Men: The Last Stand (2006)
x-men-the-last-stand-2006.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
x-men-the-last-stand-2006.overview: When a cure is found to treat mutations, lines are drawn amongst the X-Men led by Professor Charles Xavier, and Magneto's Brotherhood of Mutants.

spider-man-3-2007.label: Spider-Man 3 (2007)
spider-man-3-2007.title: Spider-Man 3
spider-man-3-2007.overview: The seemingly invincible Spider-Man goes up against an all-new crop of villains—including the shape-shifting Sandman. While Spider-Man’s superpowers are altered by an alien organism, his alter ego, Peter Parker, deals with nemesis Eddie Brock and also gets caught up in a love triangle.

fantastic-four-rise-of-the-silver-surfer.label: Fantastic Four Rise of the Silver Surfer
fantastic-four-rise-of-the-silver-surfer.title: Fantastic Four: Rise of the Silver Surfer
fantastic-four-rise-of-the-silver-surfer.overview: The Fantastic Four return to the big screen as a new and all powerful enemy threatens the Earth. The seemingly unstoppable 'Silver Surfer', but all is not what it seems and there are old and new enemies that pose a greater threat than the intrepid superheroes realize.

iron-man-may-2008.label: Iron Man (May 2008)
iron-man-may-2008.title: Iron Man
iron-man-may-2008.overview: After being held captive in an Afghan cave, billionaire engineer Tony Stark creates a unique weaponized suit of armor to fight evil.

the-incredible-hulk-jun-2008.label: The Incredible Hulk (Jun 2008)
the-incredible-hulk-jun-2008.title: The Incredible Hulk
the-incredible-hulk-jun-2008.overview: Scientist Bruce Banner scours the planet for an antidote to the unbridled force of rage within him: the Hulk. But when the military masterminds who dream of exploiting his powers force him back to civilization, he finds himself coming face to face with a new, deadly foe.

x-men-origins-wolverine-may-2009.label: X-Men Origins: Wolverine (May 2009)
x-men-origins-wolverine-may-2009.title: X-Men Origins: Wolverine
x-men-origins-wolverine-may-2009.overview: After seeking to live a normal life after 200 years, Logan sets out to avenge a death by undergoing the mutant Weapon X program and becoming Wolverine.

iron-man-2-may-2010.label: Iron Man 2 (May 2010)
iron-man-2-may-2010.title: Iron Man 2
iron-man-2-may-2010.overview: With the world now aware of his dual life as the armored superhero Iron Man, billionaire inventor Tony Stark faces pressure from the government, the press and the public to share his technology with the military. Unwilling to let go of his invention, Stark, with Pepper Potts and James 'Rhodey' Rhodes at his side, must forge new alliances – and confront powerful enemies.

thor-may-2011.label: Thor (May 2011)
thor-may-2011.title: Thor
thor-may-2011.overview: Against his father Odin's will, The Mighty Thor - a powerful but arrogant warrior god - recklessly reignites an ancient war. Thor is cast down to Earth and forced to live among humans as punishment. Once here, Thor learns what it takes to be a true hero when the most dangerous villain of his world sends the darkest forces of Asgard to invade Earth.

x-men-first-class-jun-2011.label: X-Men: First Class (Jun 2011)
x-men-first-class-jun-2011.title: X-Men: First Class
x-men-first-class-jun-2011.overview: Before Charles Xavier and Erik Lensherr took the names Professor X and Magneto, they were two young men discovering their powers for the first time. Before they were arch-enemies, they were closest of friends, working together with other mutants (some familiar, some new), to stop the greatest threat the world has ever known.

captain-america-the-first-avenger-jul-20.label: Captain America: The First Avenger (Jul 2011)
captain-america-the-first-avenger-jul-20.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
captain-america-the-first-avenger-jul-20.overview: During World War II, Steve Rogers is a sickly man from Brooklyn who's transformed into super-soldier Captain America to aid in the war effort. Rogers must stop the Red Skull – Adolf Hitler's ruthless head of weaponry, and the leader of an organization that intends to use a mysterious device of untold powers for world domination.

one-shot-the-consultant-sep-2011.label: One-Shot: The Consultant (Sep 2011)
one-shot-the-consultant-sep-2011.title: Marvel One-Shot: The Consultant
one-shot-the-consultant-sep-2011.overview: Agent Coulson informs Agent Sitwell that the World Security Council wishes Emil Blonsky to be released from prison to join the Avengers Initiative. As Nick Fury doesn't want to release Blonsky, the two agents decide to send a patsy to sabotage the meeting...

one-shot-a-funny-thing-happened-on-the-w.label: One-Shot: A Funny Thing Happened on the Way to Thor's Hammer (Oct 2011)
one-shot-a-funny-thing-happened-on-the-w.title: Marvel One-Shot: A Funny Thing Happened on the Way to Thor's Hammer
one-shot-a-funny-thing-happened-on-the-w.overview: Agent Coulson stops at a convenience store and deals with a coincidental robbery during his visit.

the-avengers-may-2012.label: The Avengers (May 2012)
the-avengers-may-2012.title: The Avengers
the-avengers-may-2012.overview: When an unexpected enemy emerges and threatens global safety and security, Nick Fury, director of the international peacekeeping agency known as S.H.I.E.L.D., finds himself in need of a team to pull the world back from the brink of disaster. Spanning the globe, a daring recruitment effort begins!

the-amazing-spider-man-jul-2012.label: The Amazing Spider-Man (Jul 2012)
the-amazing-spider-man-jul-2012.title: The Amazing Spider-Man
the-amazing-spider-man-jul-2012.overview: A teenage Peter Parker grapples with both high school and amazing super-human crises as his alter-ego Spider-Man.

one-shot-item-47-sep-2012.label: One-Shot: Item 47 (Sep 2012)
one-shot-item-47-sep-2012.title: Marvel One-Shot: Item 47
one-shot-item-47-sep-2012.overview: Benny and Claire, a down-on-their-luck couple, find a discarded Chitauri weapon referred to as 'Item 47'.

iron-man-3-may-2013.label: Iron Man 3 (May 2013)
iron-man-3-may-2013.title: Iron Man 3
iron-man-3-may-2013.overview: When Tony Stark's world is torn apart by a formidable terrorist called the Mandarin, he starts an odyssey of rebuilding and retribution.

the-wolverine-jul-2013.title: The Wolverine
the-wolverine-jul-2013.overview: Wolverine faces his ultimate nemesis - and tests of his physical, emotional, and mortal limits - in a life-changing voyage to modern-day Japan.

one-shot-agent-carter-sep-2013.title: Marvel One-Shot: Agent Carter
one-shot-agent-carter-sep-2013.overview: Agent Peggy Carter is relegated to a desk job and frustrated at her male boss and comrades' sexist dismissal of her place in the SSR. Ordered to work late one night, Carter gets an alert that the villain Zodiac has been spotted and decides to take care of it herself.

thor-the-dark-world-nov-2013.label: Thor: The Dark World (Nov 2013)
thor-the-dark-world-nov-2013.title: Thor: The Dark World
thor-the-dark-world-nov-2013.overview: Thor fights to restore order across the cosmos… but an ancient race led by the vengeful Malekith returns to plunge the universe back into darkness. Faced with an enemy that even Odin and Asgard cannot withstand, Thor must embark on his most perilous and personal journey yet, one that will reunite him with Jane Foster and force him to sacrifice everything to save us all.

one-shot-all-hail-the-king-feb-2014.overview: A documentary filmmaker interviews the now-famous Trevor Slattery from behind bars.

captain-america-the-winter-soldier-apr-2.label: Captain America: The Winter Soldier (Apr 2014)
captain-america-the-winter-soldier-apr-2.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
captain-america-the-winter-soldier-apr-2.overview: After the cataclysmic events in New York with The Avengers, Steve Rogers, aka Captain America is living quietly in Washington, D.C. and trying to adjust to the modern world. But when a S.H.I.E.L.D. colleague comes under attack, Steve becomes embroiled in a web of intrigue that threatens to put the world at risk. Joining forces with the Black Widow, Captain America struggles to expose the ever-widening conspiracy while fighting off professional assassins sent to silence him at every turn. When the full scope of the villainous plot is revealed, Captain America and the Black Widow enlist the help of a new ally, the Falcon. However, they soon find themselves up against an unexpected and formidable enemy—the Winter Soldier.

the-amazing-spider-man-2-may-2014.label: The Amazing Spider-Man 2 (May 2014)
the-amazing-spider-man-2-may-2014.title: The Amazing Spider-Man 2
the-amazing-spider-man-2-may-2014.overview: For Peter Parker, life is busy. Between taking out the bad guys as Spider-Man and spending time with the person he loves, Gwen Stacy, high school graduation cannot come quickly enough. Peter has not forgotten about the promise he made to Gwen’s father to protect her by staying away, but that is a promise he cannot keep. Things will change for Peter when a new villain, Electro, emerges, an old friend, Harry Osborn, returns, and Peter uncovers new clues about his past.

x-men-days-of-future-past-may-2014.label: X-Men: Days of Future Past (May 2014)
x-men-days-of-future-past-may-2014.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
x-men-days-of-future-past-may-2014.overview: The ultimate X-Men ensemble fights a war for the survival of the species across two time periods as they join forces with their younger selves in an epic battle that must change the past – to save our future.

guardians-of-the-galaxy-aug-2014.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
guardians-of-the-galaxy-aug-2014.overview: Light years from Earth, 26 years after being abducted, Peter Quill finds himself the prime target of a manhunt after discovering an orb wanted by Ronan the Accuser.

agent-carter-s1-jan-mar-2015.title: Marvel's Agent Carter
agent-carter-s1-jan-mar-2015.overview: It's 1946, and peace has dealt Peggy Carter a serious blow as she finds herself marginalized when the men return home from fighting abroad. Working for the covert SSR (Strategic Scientific Reserve), Peggy must balance doing administrative work and going on secret missions for Howard Stark all while trying to navigate life as a single woman in America, in the wake of losing the love of her life - Steve Rogers.

daredevil-s1-apr-2015.label: Daredevil S1 (Apr 2015)
daredevil-s1-apr-2015.title: Marvel's Daredevil
daredevil-s1-apr-2015.overview: Lawyer-by-day Matt Murdock uses his heightened senses from being blinded as a young boy to fight crime at night on the streets of Hell’s Kitchen as Daredevil.

avengers-age-of-ultron-may-2015.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
avengers-age-of-ultron-may-2015.overview: When Tony Stark tries to jumpstart a dormant peacekeeping program, things go awry and Earth’s Mightiest Heroes are put to the ultimate test as the fate of the planet hangs in the balance. As the villainous Ultron emerges, it is up to The Avengers to stop him from enacting his terrible plans, and soon uneasy alliances and unexpected action pave the way for an epic and unique global adventure.

ant-man-jul-2015.label: Ant-Man (Jul 2015)
ant-man-jul-2015.title: Ant-Man
ant-man-jul-2015.overview: Armed with the astonishing ability to shrink in scale but increase in strength, master thief Scott Lang must embrace his inner-hero and help his mentor, Doctor Hank Pym, protect the secret behind his spectacular Ant-Man suit from a new generation of towering threats. Against seemingly insurmountable obstacles, Pym and Lang must plan and pull off a heist that will save the world.

deadpool-feb-2016.title: Deadpool
deadpool-feb-2016.overview: The origin story of former Special Forces operative turned mercenary Wade Wilson, who, after being subjected to a rogue experiment that leaves him with accelerated healing powers, adopts the alter ego Deadpool. Armed with his new abilities and a dark, twisted sense of humor, Deadpool hunts down the man who nearly destroyed his life.

daredevil-s2-mar-2016.title: Marvel's Daredevil
daredevil-s2-mar-2016.overview: Lawyer-by-day Matt Murdock uses his heightened senses from being blinded as a young boy to fight crime at night on the streets of Hell’s Kitchen as Daredevil.

captain-america-civil-war-may-2016.title: Captain America: Civil War
captain-america-civil-war-may-2016.overview: Following the events of Age of Ultron, the collective governments of the world pass an act designed to regulate all superhuman activity. This polarizes opinion amongst the Avengers, causing two factions to side with Iron Man or Captain America, which causes an epic battle between former allies.

x-men-apocalypse-may-2016.title: X-Men: Apocalypse
x-men-apocalypse-may-2016.overview: After the re-emergence of the world's first mutant, world-destroyer Apocalypse, the X-Men must unite to defeat his extinction level plan.

doctor-strange-nov-2016.label: Doctor Strange (Nov 2016)
doctor-strange-nov-2016.title: Doctor Strange
doctor-strange-nov-2016.overview: After his career is destroyed, a brilliant but arrogant surgeon gets a new lease on life when a sorcerer takes him under her wing and trains him to defend the world against evil.

iron-fist-s1-mar-2017.label: Iron Fist S1 (Mar 2017)
iron-fist-s1-mar-2017.title: Marvel's Iron Fist
iron-fist-s1-mar-2017.overview: Danny Rand resurfaces 15 years after being presumed dead. Now, with the power of the Iron Fist, he seeks to reclaim his past and fulfill his destiny.

logan-mar-2017.label: Logan (Mar 2017)
logan-mar-2017.title: Logan
logan-mar-2017.overview: In the near future, a weary Logan cares for an ailing Professor X in a hideout on the Mexican border. But Logan's attempts to hide from the world and his legacy are upended when a young mutant arrives, pursued by dark forces.

guardians-of-the-galaxy-vol-2-may-2017.label: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2 (May 2017)
guardians-of-the-galaxy-vol-2-may-2017.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
guardians-of-the-galaxy-vol-2-may-2017.overview: The Guardians must fight to keep their newfound family together as they unravel the mysteries of Peter Quill's true parentage.

spider-man-homecoming-jul-2017.label: Spider-Man: Homecoming (Jul 2017)
spider-man-homecoming-jul-2017.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
spider-man-homecoming-jul-2017.overview: Following the events of Captain America: Civil War, Peter Parker, with the help of his mentor Tony Stark, tries to balance his life as an ordinary high school student in Queens, New York City, with fighting crime as his superhero alter ego Spider-Man as a new threat, the Vulture, emerges.

the-defenders-aug-2017.label: The Defenders (Aug 2017)
the-defenders-aug-2017.title: Marvel's The Defenders
the-defenders-aug-2017.overview: Daredevil, Jessica Jones, Luke Cage and Iron Fist join forces to take on common enemies as a sinister conspiracy threatens New York City.

inhumans-sep-2017.label: Inhumans (Sep 2017)
inhumans-sep-2017.title: Marvel's Inhumans
inhumans-sep-2017.overview: After the Royal Family of Inhumans is splintered by a military coup, they barely escape to Hawaii where their surprising interactions with the lush world and humanity around them may prove to not only save them, but Earth itself.

runaways-s1-nov-2017.label: Runaways (Nov 2017)
runaways-s1-nov-2017.title: Marvel's Runaways
runaways-s1-nov-2017.overview: Every teenager thinks their parents are evil. What if you found out they actually were? Six diverse teenagers who can barely stand each other must unite against a common foe – their parents.

thor-ragnarok-nov-2017.label: Thor: Ragnarok (Nov 2017)
thor-ragnarok-nov-2017.title: Thor: Ragnarok
